seo.title: Bazi Scent Reading — CHUWU 初·五
seo.description: Enter your birth date and time to reveal your Bazi Five Element balance, then build a fragrance around what you lack.

header.title: Discover the Element You're Missing
header.lede: Enter your birth date and time (as precisely as you know it) to calculate your Bazi (八字) — your Four Pillars of Destiny — and see which of the Five Elements your chart could use more of.

calc.label: How we calculate this
calc.intro:
Your chart is made of 8 characters — a Heavenly Stem (天干) and an Earthly Branch (地支) for each of your year, month, day and hour of birth. Each character is worth one point, so your five numbers always add up to 8.
A Heavenly Stem gives its full point to its own element. An Earthly Branch holds one to three hidden stems (藏干), so its point is shared between them — mostly to the main one (0.6, or 0.7 when there are two), the rest to the others (0.3 and 0.1). Here's how your own chart adds up:
calc.note: The element with the fewest points is the one your chart is lacking most. Hidden-stem weightings differ slightly between Bazi schools, and a full professional reading also weighs the season, clashes and combinations between characters — this count is a simple, transparent guide to your elemental balance.

recommend.title: Scents for Your Missing Element
recommend.lede: Your reading shows which of the Five Elements your chart could use more of — here are the CHUWU scents built for exactly that element.
recommend.explainer: Each scent is scored by how well its blend of elements fills the gaps in your chart — its balance match. Scents built mostly on an element you already have plenty of aren't suggested.

also.title: More Scents for Your Chart
also.lede: These carry other elements your chart could use more of. The match shows how well each blend fills your gaps.

build.title: Compose Your Custom Blend
build.lede: Notes highlighted in gold match the element(s) you're lacking; a dark border marks your preferred scent family. Pick 1–2 notes per layer (top, middle, base) — the price only depends on bottle size, not how many notes you choose.

disclaimer: This reading is offered as a lifestyle and inspirational guide drawing on traditional Five Element (Wu Xing) theory, and is not a substitute for a professional Bazi consultation.
